name: @la/web
description: The web app (issue #10): the language-NEUTRAL token-stream shell (src/shell — no global dir, no direction/ruby assumptions; registry keyed (lang, kind)) + the site composition layer (src/app, src/packs — the ONLY place pack /react entrants are imported and registered) + the tokens.json → CSS custom-property bridge. scripts.e2e: pnpm -w run build && pnpm run build:site && playwright test
